== Biography ==

The Champion was a warrior among the unseen people of the Valley of Voe, credited with having killed eleven bears in his time. On one occasion he escaped the bears by shouting his battle-cry. He was eventually killed by the bears themselves: witnesses recount that several pieces of him were seen scattered about, which then disappeared as the bears devoured them.
